More Power. More Comfort. More Capability.

The HX Series tractors are built to handle the toughest tasks, with incredible engine power and robust features that enhance operator comfort. Equipped with a luxury cab, intuitive controls, and unbeatable durability, the HX Series is perfect for professionals who need both performance and reliability.

Features may include:

Powerful Performance
The HX9010PC comes with a high-performance Daedong® turbocharged engine, providing outstanding power and efficiency to take on heavy-duty tasks with ease.

Climate-Controlled Cab
The deluxe cab with climate control ensures you’re comfortable regardless of the weather conditions, making it ideal for long hours of operation.

Hydrostatic Transmission
The hydrostatic transmission system provides smooth, infinitely variable speed control, giving the operator precise handling and ease of use on all terrains.

Ergonomic Operator Comfort
A fully adjustable suspension seat and ergonomic controls ensure a comfortable ride and easy handling, no matter the task.

Robust Design
Built tough, the HX Series has reinforced construction with a strong chassis and an efficient cooling system to handle even the most demanding conditions.

Enhanced Visibility
The design of the cab and hood improves operator visibility, allowing for safe operation in tight spaces and tricky conditions.

PTO Performance
The PTO system delivers reliable power to all your attachments, with independent and easy-to-engage control for precise operation.

High Capacity Fuel Tank
The large fuel tank provides extended run time, minimizing the need for frequent refueling during long work days.

Premium Features
The HX Series includes advanced features such as a powerful hydraulic system, large-capacity rear lift, and a smooth operating 4WD system.
